items.title: 21.5.1 Comparison of Reactivities of Halogenoalkanes and Halogenoarenes (dono ki reactivity ka comparison) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 21.5.1 with Quick Check 21.4 and the DDT box, printed pages 81-82.

blocks.text: Halogenoalkanes aliphatic (zanjeer wale, ring ke baghair) organic compounds hain jin mein halogen atom alkyl group se jura hota hai. Carbon aur halogen ki electronegativity mein farq ki wajah se halogen se jure carbon par partial positive (thora sa positive, δ+) charge aa jata hai aur woh electrophile ban jata hai. Yeh electrophilic carbon nucleophiles ko attack (hamle) ki dawat deta hai, aur is se reactions ki ek bari family (khandan) banti hai jise nucleophilic substitution reactions kehte hain.

Isi carbon ke saath wale carbon par lage hydrogen par bases ka attack reactions ki ek aur ahem class (qisam) deta hai, jise elimination reactions kehte hain. In reactions par pehle detail (tafseel) se baat ho chuki hai.

Lekin halogenoarenes mein chlorine atom ka electron pair (lone pair) aromatic ring ke saath shamil ho kar delocalise ho jata hai (poori ring par phail jata hai), jaisa neeche dikhaya gaya hai. Is delocalisation se carbon-halogen bond mein partial double-bond character (thori si double bond wali khoobi) aa jati hai aur bond strong (mazboot) ho jata hai. Yani C—Cl bond ki strength barh jati hai aur use torna mushkil ho jata hai. Is liye halogenoarenes kam reactive hain aur synthesis (naye compounds banane) mein kam kaam aate hain.

blocks.alt: Chlorobenzene: chhe carbons ki ring, paanch par H aur aik par Cl. Gulabi (pink) patti carbons ki ring par hai, aur Cl ke gird gulabi hissa Cl wale carbon par us se mil jata (overlap) hai.
blocks.caption: Chlorobenzene mein chlorine ke lone pair ki delocalisation (kitab ke PDF page 84 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gulabi patti benzene ring ke pi electrons hain aur Cl ke gird gulabi hissa us ka lone pair. Dono C–Cl wale carbon par mil jate hain, is liye lone pair ring mein phail jata hai. Is se C–Cl bond mein partial double-bond character aata hai, woh strong ho jata hai aur mushkil se toot'ta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Halogenoarene banane mein iron halide ka kya role (kaam) hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh Lewis acid catalyst hai: X₂ se electron pair le kar use polarise karta hai aur electrophile X⁺ (saath [FeX₄]⁻) banata hai, jo phir benzene ring par attack karta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Chlorobenzene normal conditions (aam halaat) mein NaOH se react nahi karta lekin chloroethane karta hai. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Chlorobenzene mein Cl ka lone pair ring mein delocalised hai, is liye C–Cl bond mein partial double-bond character hai aur woh strong hai; ring nucleophile ko peeche se attack karne bhi nahi deti. Chloroethane mein C–Cl aam polar bond hai jis par OH⁻ aasani se attack kar leta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Kya chlorobenzene elimination kar sakta hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Normal conditions mein nahi: C–Cl ke saath wale carbons aromatic ring ka hissa hain, is liye HCl hata kar naya double bond banane se stable aromatic ring toot jayegi; aur strong C–Cl bond bhi aasani se nahi toot'ta.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: Kuch halogen compounds, jaise DDT, pesticides (keere maar dawaiyon) ke taur par use hue. Lekin yeh environment (mahol) mein bohat der tak baqi rehte hain (persistence), is liye developed (taraqqi yafta) mulkon mein in par restriction (pabandi) lagi ya inhein band kar diya gaya. DDT sasta aur machharon ke khilaf bohat effective (kargar) hai, is liye kuch developing (taraqqi pazeer) mulkon mein is ke hatne ke baad malaria se deaths (amwaat) tezi se barh gayin. Is liye mashwara hai ke environment ki protection (hifazat) ke liye is ka use limited (mehdood) rakha jaye.

items: Halogenoalkanes: polar C–X, δ+ carbon; substitution aur elimination dono.
Halogenoarenes: Cl ka lone pair ring mein delocalised; C–Cl strong; kam reactive.
Chloroethane NaOH se react karta hai; chlorobenzene normal conditions mein nahi.
